thread:
Jason: Quick sync — planning a regional "tilt sweep" to move 10->50% traffic across NA->EU edge pools tonight. Target start 22:00 UTC. Who's owning the deploy and smoke?
Emily: I can own the deploy steps and DNS cutover. Will hand to Srinivas for post-roll smoke.
Srinivas: Got it. I'll run perf + correctness checks. ETA to be ready by 21:30 UTC.
Lina: I'll stand by on metrics and tracing dashboards, can alert on error-rate or 95th latency regressions.
Jason: Plan: gradual steps: 10% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m increments. Rollback on any of these stages if error-rate > 2x baseline or p95 increases > 40ms.
Emily: Notes on routing change: we'll apply new weighted policy in RouteManager, then update short TTL DNS as fallback. TTL is 60s for the window.
Dave: Who will execute RouteManager change? I can if Emily needs focus on DNS.
Emily: Dave please execute RouteManager change. I'll do the DNS TTL and the A-record sweep.
Srinivas: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- curl -sS https://edge-eu.example.com/health -> 200
- sample inference request to /v1/generate -> latency < 250ms median
- compare token cost per request against baseline
- check logs for model fallback events
```
Emily: Deploy-bot will post deploy job id once started. Deploy job: rdw-edge/tilt-sweep-2026-03-17.
deploy-bot: Deployment job created: rdw-edge/tilt-sweep-2026-03-17 (job_id: 0f4b2c). Starting canary tasks.
Lina: Dashboards to watch: edge-perf/region-p95, routing/errors, model-fallbacks. I'll post direct links before start.
Jason: Rollback procedure: RouteManager weight -> reset to prior weights (script: `scripts/route-revert.sh <snapshot-id>`), then restore DNS TTL if needed. Emily keep the snapshot id handy.
Emily: Snapshot saved: snap-20260317-1930. I'll paste the command in thread before start.
Srinivas: If I see any model fallbacks or >1% 5xx, I'll call immediate rollback and post screenshots of traces.
Dave: I'll wait on thumbs up from Lina for green metrics after each step.
Lina: I'll post short status at each increment: 10% OK / 25% degraded / etc. If degraded, I'll annotate and @everyone.
Jason: Small nit: confirm that dedicated caches are warmed for EU edge before full 50% (avoid cold KV thrash). Ops-bot can run warmers?
ops-bot: Cache warmer job queued: cache-warm-eu-tilt (estimated 8m).
Emily: Timeline recap: 21:30 ready checks complete -> 22:00 start -> t+0 10% -> t+30m 25% -> t+60m 50% -> 22:10/22:40 updates.
Srinivas: I'll be in the channel for the whole window. Ping me if you need me to flip rollback.
Jason: Ok. Last call for any outstanding blockers?
Dave: None from infra side. RouteManager permissions and DNS API keys are validated.
Emily: I'll post the deploy job link and the revert command 10m before start.
Jason: Great. Thanks all — see you at 21:45 here for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
